messages:
Arianna: Hey design — GTM ask for next week: we need a 3-card social carousel (1080x1080), a compact benchmark tile set (3 variants: latency, cost, throughput) for social + slide, and an A4 partner one-sheet. Localization for FR and DE only for the partner sheet. Deadline: Tue 10am PT.
Mateo: Can do. For the benchmark tiles, do you want data callouts or just relative bars/percent?
Arianna: Callouts preferred. Use callouts: p50=45ms, cost/token=$0.0009, 2.6x batching uplift. Add a tiny footnote: "internal benchmark, results may vary."
Priya: Brand rules: use Primary Blue, white backgrounds for social tiles, ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text. No drop shadows on small tiles. Also include H1 font scale + accessible alt text.
Tess: File exports needed: figma master + PNG 1080x1080 (three frames), export SVGs for each tile, PDF A4 partner sheet in FR and DE, and a single-page PNG for email. Name with gtm_carousel_v1.png, gtm_bench_tiles_v1.zip (contains PNG+SVG), gtm_partner_sheet_fr_v1.pdf, gtm_partner_sheet_de_v1.pdf. Tag #gtm-assets.
Jamal: Quick legal: avoid customer logos and percentages claiming SLA. The uplift stat is ok with "based on internal tests" footnote. Also check imagery for regulated industries.
Mateo: For the carousel motion, prefer subtle slide-in of value numbers. GIF ok under 2MB for Instagram. For Twitter/X keep static PNGs.
Arianna: Mobile-first: ensure text legible at 320px. Also provide a stacked variant for narrow displays (1080x1350).
Priya: Localization note: translate only main headlines and data labels. Keep legal footnote in English at the bottom. Leave line-wrap buffer for German copy.
Tess: I'll add export checklist and a short handoff doc for SDRs: recommended email subject lines, short blurb, and the partner sheet links.
Mateo: Uploading first comps to Figma in ~4h. Frames named: CAROUSEL_1..3, BENCH_A..C, PARTNER_MASTER.
design-bot: Reminder set 16h to follow up if comps not uploaded.
Arianna: Thanks. Priya and Jamal to QA/legal before Tue 10am. If any blocker, push partner sheet release and hold carousel.
Mateo: Noted, will ping when ready for review.
Priya: I'll review accessibility and localization buffer after comps are uploaded.
Jamal: I'll check legal copy once comps posted.
